candidate.user_input: Compare permitted cabin upgrades for domestic versus international flights, including conditions for the international business-class exception. Preserve continuous-flight duration and trip-purpose qualifiers.
candidate.reference: Domestic flights over 5 hours consecutive flight time allow booking the next class up from standard economy below business class. International flights over 5 hours consecutive flight time allow the same upgrade. For international flights exceeding 8 hours consecutive flight time, frequent travelers (3+ trips per quarter) may book business class when traveling for customer meetings, speaking engagements, or representing GitLab at conferences.

evidence.quote: For domestic flights with a duration greater than 5 hours of consecutive flight time (each segment must be 5+ hours), team members are authorized to book the next class up from standard economy as long as it is below business class.
evidence.contribution: Defines domestic flight upgrade policy for flights over 5 hours consecutive flight time.

evidence.quote:
For international flights with a duration greater than 5 hours of consecutive flight time (each segment must be 5+ hours), team members are authorized to book the next class up from standard economy as long as it is below business class.
- Flights exceeding 8 hours of consecutive flight time - For those who travel frequently, defined as 3 or more trips per quarter internationally on flights of 8 hrs+ continuous flight time (minimum 6 flight segments with 8+ hours per segment), business class is permitted when traveling for any of the following reasons:
  - Meeting with customers
  - Speaking engagement
  - Representing GitLab at a conference
evidence.contribution: Defines international flight upgrade policy including business class exception for frequent travelers on long flights with specific trip purposes.

candidate.connection: Context 0 defines domestic flight upgrade rules; Context 1 defines international flight upgrade rules and business class exceptions, enabling a direct comparison.

source_conditions: Domestic flights: duration greater than 5 hours of consecutive flight time (each segment must be 5+ hours)
Domestic flights: permitted to book next class up from standard economy, below business class
International flights: duration greater than 5 hours of consecutive flight time (each segment must be 5+ hours)
International flights: permitted to book next class up from standard economy, below business class
International flights: business class permitted for flights exceeding 8 hours of consecutive flight time
International flights: business class permitted only for frequent travelers (3+ trips per quarter internationally on flights of 8+ hours, minimum 6 flight segments with 8+ hours per segment)
International flights: business class permitted only when traveling for meeting with customers, speaking engagement, or representing GitLab at a conference
missing_conditions: International business class exception: minimum 6 flight segments with 8+ hours per segment is required in addition to 3+ trips per quarter; this is omitted in the answer.
question_issues: Question includes an instruction intended for the generator.
issues: The answer omits the requirement that frequent international travelers must have a minimum of 6 flight segments with 8+ hours per segment to qualify for business class. This is a critical qualifying threshold for the exception and its omission makes the answer incomplete and not fully grounded.
